name: Day planner
summary: Plans your day, finds time, tells you when to leave and what to bring to a meeting.

requires.why: To put a slot in your calendar when you say yes.
If something here remembers people, to tell you what it knows before a meeting.
If something here can list your mail, to find messages about a meeting. It only reads.

settings.label: Travel time (minutes)
settings.hint: How long before an event with a place to tell you to leave. A fixed time: no live traffic is used.

settings.label: Home
settings.hint: A place label as it appears on your events. Events there need no travel.
